Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing penalty for violation of Title 51 RCW.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to violation of Title 51 RCW; amending RCW51.48.080; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 51.48.080 and 1985 c 347 s 7 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Every person, firm or corporation who violates or fails to obey,observe or comply with this title or any rule of the departmentpromulgated under authority of this title, shall be subject to apenalty of not to exceed five hundred dollars.
